sections.title: What is a PCard?
paragraphs: Purchasing Cards or PCards are commercial cards that are simil ar to credit cards. PCards can be utilized by organizations for th e purchase of goods and service s. While many SciQuest clients utilize PCards outside of the SelectSite platform, PCard functionality can also be configured and implemented in SelectSite.
Why use PCard?
• Convenience & Simplicity
• Discount or rebate benefits from Vendors
• Low dollar purchases
Enabling PCard in SelectSite
Configuration:

• PCard settings can be configured in Site Configuration o Use PCard: Activates the functionality in the site and allows PCards to be applied at the user or supplier level. o A PO number wheel can be applied to all PCard orders.

sections.title: PCard at the User Level:
paragraphs: PCard at the User Level:
• PCards can be applied at the user level. The permissions that d ictate whether or not a user can manage their PCards are located under the Cart/Requisition permissions.
• Purchasing departments, site administrators or users can then a pply cards to the profile of the users. (Note: Card number 4111111111111111 can be used for testing purposes)

sections.title: • Users can also be assigned a PCard purchasing limit
paragraphs: • Users can also be assigned a PCard purchasing limit PCard at the Purchasing Level
• PCards can be applied at the pur chasing level rather than applying PCards at the user level.
PCard at the Supplier Level***GhostCard***
• PCard can also be activated or de activated at the supplier leve l.

sections.title: • Select “Ghost Card”, under the Or dering > Payment Method tab, a nd enter Card Details.
paragraphs: • Select “Ghost Card”, under the Or dering > Payment Method tab, a nd enter Card Details.
Workflow
• Below are two key questions to ask the client when determining how workflow needs to be designed for PCard. o Do PCard purchases need to f ollow the same PR workflow?
• Typically approvals are not nece ssary for PCard purchases since users a given a PCard purchasing limit.
• ADW can be utilized for routing PCard orders. o Do POs need to be distributed to the Supplier and exported to t he ERP?

• It is important to discuss how PCards will be handled in regard s to distribution and ERP integrations. If the pur chase was made after the fact t hen the order does not need to be re‐distribut ed. Some organizations may not need to export

sections.title: Advantages
paragraphs: PCard purchases because the purch ase does not meet encumbrance requirements.
• Capturing a true representation of an organization’s spend
• Ease of Use
• Allows purchasing departments to control spend
• Leverage better pricing with suppliers
Challenges
• Adopting PCard at the user level
• Transaction limits can be applie d to PCards but we are currentl y unable to apply credit limits for PCard
• Different reconciliation processes***
